title: Nearly minimal maxima and positive minima of Littlewood polynomials
summary: For every η > 0 and every sufficiently large integer N , there is a polynomial with N consecutive coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ whose modulus lies between $`\sqrt N/16`$ and $`(1+\eta)\sqrt N`$ everywhere on the unit circle.
family_title: Real ultraflat Littlewood polynomials and unbounded binary merit factors

review.reason: Shows existence of ±1 polynomials with nearly minimal sup norm on the unit circle.
